svg.title: Six equally likely ordered spinner outcomes give unequal probabilities for their totals
svg.desc: The first fair spinner has results one and two, and the second fair spinner has results one, two and three. The spins are independent. Each ordered pair therefore has probability one half times one third, one sixth. The grid lists first-spinner rows one and two and second-spinner columns one, two and three. The six cells are one one, one two, one three, two one, two two and two three, with sums two, three, four, three, four and five. The two cells one two and two one are highlighted because their sum is three. The sum probabilities for two, three, four and five are one sixth, one third, one third and one sixth. Thus probability of sum three is two sixths, one third. Counting the four possible totals as equally likely would be incorrect.
